name: Prince William County, VA
findings: Prince William County has 1,404 nonprofit organizations. 567 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 449 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Prince William County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Prince William County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 169 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 169 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: 3 religious organizations here list civic or political action. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to take civic or political action through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
